Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_ReturnEmptyCa: Return an empty capsule after unpacking
When on, the player who threw the capsule gets an empty capsule back after the vehicle appears, ready to pack another vehicle.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_PackPermissio:
With Minidoracat Vehicle Manager installed, a claimed vehicle can only be packed by its owner and by players the owner shared Tow with (admins need its override on); this option covers unclaimed vehicles.
Key holders: the player carries this vehicle's key, or the key is in the ignition.
Anyone: every player can pack.
Admins only: regular players cannot pack.
Admins can always pack, whatever this option says.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_ZombieSoundRa: Zombie attraction radius of the capsule sound (tiles)
0 to 50 tiles. 0 means the capsule popping open does not attract zombies.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_AllowCargoTak: Allow taking cargo out of capsules

When on, players can take cargo out of a loaded capsule without unpacking the vehicle. Items can only be taken out, never put in. A freshly packed capsule opens after about 5 seconds; a capsule left unconfirmed by a server crash stays locked.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_RecordRetenti:
1 to 90 days. Records of capsules that were unpacked, restored or voided are deleted once their last event is older than this. Packed and unconfirmed records are always kept: they are needed to restore a vehicle.
Records live on the server in Zomboid/Lua/MinidoracatCapsule/, one folder per world; back them up with the world save.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_LootEnabled_t:
Master switch: when off, none of the four locations below spawn empty capsules.
Only affects containers opened for the first time afterwards; containers already looted do not respawn.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_LootMechanicW: 0 to 10, the same scale as vanilla loot table weights. Higher means more common.
Sandbox_MinidoracatCapsule_LootCarSupply: 0 to 10, the same scale as vanilla loot table weights. Higher means more common.
